Evidence: Congress party ne kaha hai ki petrol aur diesel par excise duty cut se aam logon ko koi asli rahat nahi mil rahi hai, aur sarkar logon ko headlines se fool kar rahi hai (Source 1). Congress ne yeh bhi kaha ki jab global crude oil prices girte hain, tab bhi India mein consumer prices nahi ghatte (Source 3). Rahul Gandhi ne bhi prices ghatane ki maang ki hai, lekin yeh sirf election ke nazdeek aane par ho raha hai (Source 2). Congress ke leaders ne yeh bhi bataya ki actual relief sirf narrative mein hai, na ki reality mein (Source 1, 3).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh pata chalta hai ki Congress party petrol aur diesel ki prices ko ghatane ki maang kar rahi hai, lekin unka kehna hai ki sarkar sirf headlines bana rahi hai aur asli relief nahi de rahi (Source 1, 3). Isliye, yeh claim ki Congress ko petrol aur diesel ki prices Rs 40 karne ka sandesh dena chahiye, yeh evidence se contradict hota hai kyunki Congress khud is par criticism kar rahi hai aur asli relief nahi milne ki baat kar rahi hai (Source 1, 3).
